items.title: createInviteStep
items.description: This step creates one or more invites.

items.title: deleteInvitesStep
items.description: This step deletes one or more invites.

items.title: refreshInviteTokensStep
items.description: This step refreshes the tokens of one or more invites.

items.title: validateTokenStep
items.description:
This step validates a specified token and returns its associated invite.
If not valid, the step throws an error.
